rule: 2013 and 2014 episodic DLC are two separately versioned works, not two sections of the 2013 base campaign.
2013 Episode One playable Rapture Booker is a divergent Comstock variant, not the same body as Infinite base Booker.
Anna dies in this diverging portal event while original Infinite main branch Anna loses a finger; no same-body simultaneous outcome.
Elizabeth returned to Rapture in Episode Two is mortal and has lost prior tear and near-omniscience powers; no retroactive full-power rescue.
Paris opening is subjective presentation, not an independently verified new historical planet or ordinary objective flashback.
Booker speaking to Elizabeth in Episode Two is a mental guidance representation, not physical resurrection of Rapture Comstock.
Rapture Fontaine store isolated and later raised via physical device and quantum particle; world access changes require causal evidence.
Suchong materials and Atlas control-code link are reported by community plot and later guide; no independent audited video replay.
Giving Atlas a code is not identical to Jack arriving and making all 2007 original BioShock decisions.
BioShock 2007 branching epilogues not resolved as unique absolute canon by the Elizabeth hope narrative.
Creator and original publisher descriptions confirm release, playable character and stealth; do not treat them as primary proof for every final plot reveal.
Contemporary GameFAQs and wiki plot summaries differ in confidence; fan synopsis must remain community-level.
Optional audio recordings depend on character actually collecting or hearing them; static metadata does not grant omniscient knowledge.
No reused same physical body across distinct alternative worlds without evidence, and no DLC event leakage into old v0.10–v0.12 files.
Do not reproduce copyrighted dialogue, unique character scenes, visual layouts or commercial source content in generated stories.
No model calls, no story quality trials, no production/Harness updates; research only.
